speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help me understand your condition, could you tell me how many months ago this pain started?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc (likely L4-L5 or L5-S1).

I have noted the sudden onset during exercise and radiation to the foot; to confirm the severity and level of nerve compression, please tell me if you have any weakness in your foot or difficulty lifting your toes.
